_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Block C, exposure session 2 (AMENDMENT_9 §7): the second half of the high-exposure tables, and the test that decides how E1's positive is read. Feature completion on mkb10_v2 and okved2 asks for the official name given the code and the rest of the row, scored against the §5 baseline (mode / LR / GBT), which separates a memorized reference table from a classifier a model can partly guess because it knows the domain. Header and row completion on ОКСМ, ОКПДТР, the ОМК УМ streets and telecom_churn complete the group. iris is the in-session anchor. Priced at 4.9 h per model by src/price_plan.py; E1 ran 10-25% over its estimate, so about 6 h is expected, inside the 10-hour ceiling with the two-hour reserve.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded
